- Red: 25-28 (moved with agent, as expected)
- Blue: 31-34 (moved from 19-22!)
- Green: 37-40 (moved from 25-28!)
So when I moved DOWN while connected to Red, Blue and Green ALSO moved down! This contradicts my earlier observation that DOWN only moves the connected block.
Let me reconsider. Before moving DOWN:
- Red: 13-16 (connected, uncollected)
- Blue: 19-22 (collected)
- Green: 25-28 (collected)
- Agent: 12-17
After moving DOWN 2 times:
- Red: 25-28 (connected, moved with agent)
- Blue: 31-34 (collected, moved down by 12 rows)
- Green: 37-40 (collected, moved down by 12 rows)
- Agent: 24-29
So ALL blocks moved down by 12 rows (2 moves * 6 rows per move). This means when moving DOWN, all collected blocks below the agent also move with the agent!
But earlier, when I moved DOWN from 18-23 to 24-29, Red (at 19-22, collected, below agent) did NOT move. Let me check that case again.
Earlier case:
- Before: Red 19-22 (collected), Agent 18-23
- After: Red 19-22 (collected, didn't move), Agent 24-29
So Red was BELOW the agent (19-22 vs 18-23), and it didn't move when the agent moved DOWN.
But in the current case:
- Before: Blue 19-22, Green 25-28, Agent 12-17
- After: Blue 31-34, Green 37-40, Agent 24-29
Blue and Green were BELOW the agent, and they DID move when the agent moved DOWN.
What's different? In the earlier case, Red was at 19-22 and the agent was at 18-23. Red was just below the agent. In the current case, Blue was at 19-22 and the agent was at 12-17. Blue was further below the agent.
Hmm, maybe the mechanic is: when moving DOWN, collected blocks that are between the agent's start and end positions move with the agent. In the earlier case:
- Agent: 18-23 -> 24-29
- Red: 19-22 is between 18-23 and 24-29
- But Red didn't move!
In the current case:
- Agent: 12-17 -> 24-29
- Blue: 19-22 is between 12-17 and 24-29
- Green: 25-28 is NOT between 12-17 and 24-29 (it's below 24-29)
- But both Blue and Green moved!
This doesn't match the "between start and end" hypothesis.
Wait, let me reconsider. In the current case, the agent moved from 12-17 to 24-29 (2 DOWN moves). Blue moved from 19-22 to 31-34 (12 rows down), Green moved from 25-28 to 37-40 (12 rows down). So both moved by the same amount as the agent (12 rows).
But in the earlier case, the agent moved from 18-23 to 24-29 (1 DOWN move). Red was at 19-22. If the mechanic is "all blocks below agent move down", then Red should have moved from 19-22 to 25-28. But it didn't.
Hmm, maybe the mechanic depends on whether the agent is connected to a block? In the current case, the agent was connected to Red. In the earlier case, the agent was NOT connected to any block (I had retracted the path).
Let me check: in the earlier case, when I moved DOWN from 18-23 to 24-29, was the agent connected to any block?
Looking at the history: I had retracted the path before moving DOWN. So the agent was NOT connected.
In the current case, the agent WAS connected to Red.
So the mechanic might be:
- When moving DOWN while connected to a block: all collected blocks below the agent also move with the agent
- When moving DOWN while NOT connected: only the connected block moves (but there is no connected block, so nothing moves)
Let me verify with another case. Earlier, when I moved DOWN from 24-29 to 30-35 while connected to Blue:
- Before: Red 19-22 (collected), Blue 25-28 (connected), Agent 24-29
- After: Red 19-22 (collected, didn't move), Blue 31-34 (connected, moved), Agent 30-35
Red was ABOVE the agent, and it didn't move. Blue was connected and moved. So this is consistent with "when moving DOWN while connected, only the connected block moves" (not all blocks below).
But in the current case, Blue and Green (both collected, below agent) moved when the agent moved DOWN while connected to Red. This contradicts the earlier observation.
Wait, let me re-examine. In the earlier case:
- Before: Red 19-22 (collected), Blue 25-28 (connected), Agent 24-29
- After: Red 19-22 (collected, didn't move), Blue 31-34 (connected, moved), Agent 30-35
Red was ABOVE the agent (19-22 vs 24-29). So Red didn't move because it was above, not below.
In the current case:
- Before: Blue 19-22 (collected), Green 25-28 (collected), Agent 12-17
- After: Blue 31-34 (collected, moved), Green 37-40 (collected, moved), Agent 24-29
Blue and Green were BELOW the agent (19-22 and 25-28 vs 12-17). So they moved because they were below.
So the mechanic is:
- When moving DOWN while connected: connected block + all collected blocks below the agent move with the agent
- When moving UP while connected: connected block + all collected blocks above the agent move with the agent
This is symmetric! When moving in a direction, the connected block and all collected blocks in that direction (relative to the agent) move with the agent.
Let me verify:
- Earlier, moving UP from 36-41 to 24-29 while connected to Green:
  - Before: Red 25-28, Blue 31-34, Green 37-40 (connected), Agent 36-41
  - After: Red 13-16, Blue 19-22, Green 25-28, Agent 24-29
  - Red and Blue were ABOVE the agent (25-28 and 31-34 vs 36-41). They moved up. Consistent!
- Earlier, moving DOWN from 24-29 to 30-35 while connected to Blue:
  - Before: Red 19-22, Blue 25-28 (connected), Agent 24-29
  - After: Red 19-22, Blue 31-34, Agent 30-35
  - Red was ABOVE the agent (19-22 vs 24-29). It didn't move. Consistent!
- Earlier, moving DOWN from 18-23 to 24-29 while NOT connected:
  - Before: Red 19-22 (collected), Agent 18-23
  - After: Red 19-22, Agent 24-29
  - Red was BELOW the agent (19-22 vs 18-23). It didn't move because the agent was NOT connected. Consistent!
Great, so the mechanic is:
- When moving in a direction while connected to a block: connected block + all collected blocks in that direction (relative to the agent) move with the agent
- When moving in a direction while NOT connected: no blocks move
This makes sense! So the strategy is:
- To move a block down: connect to any block, then move DOWN. All collected blocks below the agent move down.
- To move a block up: connect to any block, then move UP. All collected blocks above the agent move up.
Given this, the current state is:
- Red: 25-28 (collected) ✓
- Blue: 31-34 (collected)
- Green: 37-40 (collected)
- Agent: 24-29
Desired:
- Red: 25-28 ✓
- Green: 31-34
- Blue: 37-40
So I need to swap Blue and Green. Blue is at 31-34 and should be at 37-40. Green is at 37-40 and should be at 31-34.
Strategy:
1. Move Blue from 31-34 to 37-40:
   - Connect to any block (e.g., Red at 25-28)
   - Move DOWN to 36-41 - Blue and Green (both below agent) move down
   - But this moves Green from 37-40 to 43-46, which is not desired.
2. Alternative: move Green from 37-40 to 31-34:
   - Connect to any block
   - Move UP to 18-23 - Red and Blue (both above agent) move up
   - But this moves Red from 25-28 to 13-16, which is not desired.
Hmm, the problem is that moving in one direction moves ALL blocks in that direction, not just the one I want.

1. Connect to Blue (at 31-34)
2. Move DOWN to 36-41 - Blue (connected) + Green (below agent) move down

5. Move UP to 30-35 - Green (connected) + Red (above agent) move up

   - Red: 25-28 -> 19-22
   - Blue: 37-40 (below agent, doesn't move)
6. Retract - Green at 37-40, Red at 19-22
This doesn't work either because it messes up Red.
OK, let me think more carefully. The key insight is: when moving while connected, blocks in the direction of movement move with the agent. So:
- Move DOWN while connected: blocks below agent move down
- Move UP while connected: blocks above agent move up
To swap Blue and Green without affecting Red:
1. Move agent below Red but above Blue: agent at 30-35
   - Red is above agent (25-28 vs 30-35)
   - Blue is below agent (31-34 vs 30-35) - wait, 31-34 overlaps with 30-35
   - Green is below agent (37-40 vs 30-35)
2. Connect to Blue (at 31-34)
3. Move DOWN to 36-41 - Blue (connected) + Green (below agent) move down
   - Blue: 31-34 -> 37-40

   - Red: 25-28 (above agent, doesn't move)
4. Retract - Blue at 37-40, Green at 43-46
5. Now move agent to 42-47 (below Green)
6. Connect to Green (at 43-46)
7. Move UP to 30-35 - Green (connected) moves up
   - Green: 43-46 -> 31-34
   - Red: 25-28 (above agent... wait, agent is at 42-47, so Red is above agent)
   - But when moving UP, blocks above agent move up. So Red would move from 25-28 to 19-22!
This still messes up Red.
Hmm, what if I position the agent between Red and Green when moving UP?

- Green: 43-46

If I move agent to 30-35:

Move UP to 30-35:

This messes up everything!
OK, I think the issue is that I can't selectively move blocks. When moving UP, ALL blocks above the agent move. When moving DOWN, ALL blocks below the agent move.
